newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta index ends down, off low after buy back.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta index ends down, off low after buy back.

text.p: Jakarta share prices ended down but off its daily low on Monday after bargain hunters bought back blue chip stocks such as Sampoerna and Semen Gresik, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index closed 6.50 points, or 0.99 percent lower, at 649.62 points after falling to 646.94 points earlier.
Losers led gainers by 94 to 31, with 62 counters unchanged. Total turnover was modest at 336.23 billion rupiah with about 135.8 million shares changing hands.
